Executive Summary

The Urban Planning and Development Authority Procedures Manual aims to unify and streamline the approved technical requirements for the services provided by the Authority. The issuance of this Manual has coincided with the launch of the PLANNING system that allows licensed engineering offices in the Kingdom of Bahrain to submit planning applications for individuals and companies, inquire about the status of applications, obtain advisory services by government agencies concerned with planning services, and pay fees for services. The Manual also facilitates for applicants to obtain all the information that helps them to prepare the documents and drawings required for submission of applications by displaying all requirements, legislations and documents related to planning services.

The Manual contains the technical requirements of the Urban Planning and Development Authority applications for the following government agencies:

o **Ministry of Housing and Urban planning:**
  • Urban Planning and Development Authority.

o **Ministry of Works:**
  • Road Planning and Design Directorate.
  • Sanitary Engineering Planning & Projects Directorate.

o **Ministry of Municipalities affairs and Agriculture:**
  • Agriculture Engineering & Water Resources Directorate.

o **Electricity and Water Authority:**

### Guide to Strengthening Child and Student Protection Procedures in Educational Institutions in the Kingdom of Bahrain

426.65 KB, 13 Pages

This Guide sets out the approved procedural framework for addressing cases and situations that may affect the safety or rights of children or students within educational institutions. It defines the roles and responsibilities, as well as the mechanisms for reporting, handling, documenting, referring, and following up on such cases, thereby ensuring standardized procedures and a prompt and effective response. The Guide also outlines the procedures for dealing with cases according to their nature and level of severity and specifies the measures to be followed by the relevant entities and parties. This enhances integration and coordination among them and supports the provision of a safe and supportive educational environment that safeguards children and students, preserves their dignity and rights, and ensures their protection. The third chapter is dedicated to the implementation of the framework, covering regulatory procedures, teaching and learning strategies, educational activities and learning resources, educational programs, assessment and evaluation strategies, the roles associated with implementing the curriculum, and the learning environment. The appendix includes a competency matrix outlining learning experiences in the early childhood stage.
